part.text:
I couldn't filter the room list. The app is on the "All chats" screen, but I have no way to tap the Search field from this environment.

- `xcrun simctl` has no tap or touch command. Its `io` subcommand only takes screenshots, and `ui` only changes appearance and text size.
- `idb` and `axe` are not installed.
- A `cliclick` binary exists in a bench shim cache, but the task rules out host-level synthetic mouse events, so I did not use it.

The screen shows rooms including "Book Club", which matches "Book", but the list is not filtered.

To finish, someone needs to tap the "Search" field at the top of the list and type "Book". Alternatively, I can try again if a tap-capable tool becomes available.
